{"sql": "WITH q AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1'
              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS quarter,
         sum(i.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1') AS q1_gmv,
  max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q2') AS q2_gmv,
  round(100.0*(max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q2') - max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1'))
        / nullif(max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1'),0), 2) AS change_pct
FROM q;"}

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH q AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat,
         CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2'
              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' END AS qtr,
         oi.price
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
), agg AS (
  SELECT cat,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q1' THEN price ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_q1,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q2' THEN price ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_q2
  FROM q GROUP BY cat
), both AS (
  SELECT cat, gmv_q1, gmv_q2, gmv_q2 - gmv_q1 AS diff
  FROM agg WHERE gmv_q1 > 0 AND gmv_q2 > 0
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both WHERE diff < 0) AS declining_categories,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both) AS compared_categories,
  (SELECT cat FROM both ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_category,
  (SELECT diff FROM both ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_amount,
  (SELECT gmv_q1 FROM both ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_q1_gmv,
  (SELECT gmv_q2 FROM both ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_q2_gmv
FROM (SELECT 1) t;"}

         COUNT(CASE WHEN qtr='Q1' THEN 1 END) AS items_q1,

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH q2 AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_status, c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
    AND c.customer_state IN ('SP','RJ')
),
buyers AS (
  SELECT customer_state, count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS buyers, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders
  FROM q2 GROUP BY customer_state
),
gmv AS (
  SELECT q.customer_state, sum(i.price) AS gmv
  FROM q2 q JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE q.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
  GROUP BY q.customer_state
)
SELECT b.customer_state, b.buyers, b.orders, g.gmv,
       round(g.gmv / b.buyers, 2) AS gmv_per_buyer,
       round(g.gmv / b.orders, 2) AS gmv_per_order
FROM buyers b JOIN gmv g USING(customer_state)
ORDER BY b.customer_state;"}

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH q AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1'
              WHEN order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS quarter,
         extract(epoch FROM(order_delivered_customer_date-order_purchase_timestamp))/86400.0 AS d
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_status='delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
)
SELECT avg(d) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1') AS q1_days,
       avg(d) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q2') AS q2_days,
       avg(d) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q2') - avg(d) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1') AS change_days,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1') AS q1_orders,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q2') AS q2_orders
FROM q"}

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH q2 AS (
  SELECT order_id, order_status FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
),
items AS (
  SELECT sum(i.price) AS item_total, sum(i.freight_value) AS freight_total
  FROM q2 JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE q2.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
),
pays AS (
  SELECT sum(p.payment_value) AS payment_total
  FROM q2 JOIN order_payments p USING(order_id)
  WHERE q2.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
)
SELECT items.item_total, items.freight_total, pays.payment_total,
       pays.payment_total - items.item_total AS payment_minus_item,
       pays.payment_total - (items.item_total + items.freight_total) AS payment_minus_item_freight
FROM items CROSS JOIN pays;"}

  SELECT i.order_id, sum(i.price) AS price_sum, sum(i.freight_value) AS freight_sum, count(*) AS item_lines
  FROM order_items i JOIN valid USING(order_id) GROUP BY i.order_id
),

  (SELECT count(*) FROM valid v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id=v.order_id)) AS valid_orders_no_items,

  (SELECT sum(b.pay_sum - a.price_sum) FROM item_agg a JOIN pay_agg b USING(order_id)) AS payment_minus_item_matched,
  (SELECT sum(a.freight_sum) FROM item_agg a) AS freight_matched,
  (SELECT sum(a.price_sum) FROM item_agg a) AS item_matched,
  (SELECT sum(b.pay_sum) FROM pay_agg b) AS payment_matched;"}
